EXPERIENCE IN MEDICINE DEPARTMENT "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;This in D.Naga Sai Rohith Naidu \u0026nbsp;a medical student from India. Welcome to my blog .I came to postings when I am in my 3rd semester i don't know how to take a case, what are the things to ask ,how to examine a patient ,how to present myself \u0026nbsp;towards a patient how to present a case, slowly with my pgs and with \u0026nbsp;my hod \u0026nbsp;help i learned how to take a proper history of a patient .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAs it is very clear that Case taking and history taking are fundamental aspects of the medical \u0026nbsp;practice. They play a crucial role in gathering relevant information about a patient's condition, which helps in making an accurate diagnosis and developing an appropriate treatment plan. With the help of this Case taking and history taking provided me an opportunity \u0026nbsp;to establish a rapport with the patients. \u0026nbsp;I established a patient and doctor relationship which feels so excited \u0026nbsp;to me.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis blog system helps us to keep every information together in a place which is very useful.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENOTE: THIS IS AN ONLINE E LOGBOOK TO DISCUSS OUR PATIENT'S DE-IDENTIFIED HEALTH DATA SHARED AFTER TAKING HIS\/HER GUARDIAN'S SIGNED INFORMED CONSENT. HERE WE DISCUSS OUR INDIVIDUAL PATIENT'S PROBLEMS THROUGH A SERIES OF INPUTS FROM THE AVAILABLE GLOBAL ONLINE COMMUNITY OF EXPERTS INTENDING TO SOLVE THOSE CLINICAL PROBLEMS WITH COLLECTIVE CURRENT BEST EVIDENCE-BASED INPUT.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EComing to my case\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/dnagasairohith38.blogspot.com\/2023\/01\/42-yr-old-male-with-abdominal-distension.html\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/dnagasairohith38.blogspot.com\/2023\/01\/42-yr-old-male-with-abdominal-distension.html\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThat was my 6th sem ,i posted in the department of general medicine ,That was an op day.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere were full of patients in the general medicine \u0026nbsp;op there I encountered this Case of 42 year old male patient complaining with abdominal distention \u0026nbsp;since 10 Days ,Swelling In Both the legs since 5 Days ,As I examined him we came to a conclusion that he had ascites.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI \u0026nbsp;am so excited to examine this patient for the 1st tym I checked for \u0026nbsp;fluid thrill, puddle sign ,shifting dullness which are positive .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThen I send the investigations to further confirm the diagnosis\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELiver function tests (such as liver enzyme levels), kidney function tests, and blood cell counts are performed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAscitic fluid analysis: Ascitic fluid is a sample of the fluid extracted from the abdominal cavity through a procedure called paracentesis. The fluid is then analyzed to determine its composition and help identify the cause of ascites.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAnalysis shows cell count ,This determines the number and types of cells present in the fluid. It can help differentiate between infection, malignancy.Protein and albumin levels \u0026nbsp;in the ascitic fluid can provide information about the severity and underlying cause of ascites. Ascitic fluid may be cultured to identify the presence of bacteria or other microorganisms and determine the appropriate antibiotic treatment if there is an infection.Cytology -ascitic fluid may be examined under a microscope to check for the presence of cancer cells.\u003C\/p\u003E"},"link":[{"rel":"replies","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/dnagasairohith38.blogspot.com\/feeds\/2487757625561174811\/comments\/default","title":"Post Comments"},{"rel":"replies","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/dnagasairohith38.blogspot.com\/2023\/05\/my-experience-in-medicine-department.html#comment-form","title":"0 Comments"},{"rel":"edit","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/8962971291964953156\/posts\/default\/2487757625561174811"},{"rel":"self","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/8962971291964953156\/posts\/default\/2487757625561174811"},{"rel":"alternate","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/dnagasairohith38.blogspot.com\/2023\/05\/my-experience-in-medicine-department.html","title":"MY EXPERIENCE IN MEDICINE DEPARTMENT "}],"author":[{"name":{"$t":"D NAGASAI ROHITH ROLL NO 38"},"uri":{"$t":"http:\/\/www.blogger.com\/profile\/04919865207224644758"},"email":{"$t":"noreply@blogger.com"},"gd$image":{"rel":"http://schemas.google.com/g/2005#thumbnail","width":"16","height":"16","src":"https:\/\/img1.blogblog.com\/img\/b16-rounded.gif"}}],"thr$total":{"$t":"0"}},{"id":{"$t":"tag:blogger.com,1999:blog-8962971291964953156.post-4348763086974406876"},"published":{"$t":"2023-04-24T03:00:00.000-07:00"},"updated":{"$t":"2023-05-30T22:34:37.857-07:00"},"title":{"type":"text","$t":"A 37 Yr old male C\/0 pain and swelling in Right Thigh "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003Cspan style=\"caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003EThis is an online e log book to discuss our patient de-identified health data shared after taking his \/ her \/ guardians signed informed consent.
